name: shop-with-openmerchant-custom
description: Find and recommend products or services from merchants on OpenMerchant, compare price and availability, request quotes, and complete purchases with an app-held payment credential.

interface.longDescription: Find or recommend products and services through OpenMerchant—including appointments, diagnostics, and lab tests—compare price and availability, request quotes, and complete purchases when your app supplies an accepted payment credential. Recommendation and advice requests are treated as catalog searches. Search needs no account; optional sign-in reuses saved contact details and addresses. Card numbers never pass through the chat.
defaultPrompt: Find a ceramic pour-over coffee dripper under $40.
Recommend a women's health panel I can get in Las Vegas.
Check out the cart and ship it to my office.
